info.title: knobd
info.description: knobd's local control API, served over a unix domain socket (see specs/adr/0004-ipc-over-unix-socket.md). Not a public/networked API: filesystem permissions on the socket are the entire access control mechanism.

get.description: Live sinks, sources and streams, for the UI's target/app pickers. Streams carry their raw PipeWire property bag and which configured app matchers currently match them.

503.description: No audio provider is wired up, or the audio backend didn't answer in time.

get.summary: Get what this daemon build actually supports
get.description: Which action types have a registered handler, which target kinds resolve, and which optional features (layers, scenes, learn) are available -- so the UI can reflect reality instead of hard-coding it.
Returns the configuration the daemon is running right now.

503.description: No configuration store is wired up.

put.description: Validates, applies to the running engine, and durably persists a new configuration. Takes effect immediately; no restart needed.

400.description: Malformed JSON, an unsupported schemaVersion, or a config that fails validation.

503.description: No configuration store is wired up.

get.description: A Server-Sent Events stream: a hello frame, then a full state snapshot on connect, then state/config_changed/learn_input frames as they occur. See specs/adr/0004-ipc-over-unix-socket.md's Update (M07).

503.description: No event hub is wired up.

delete.description: Disarms learn mode if armed; a no-op otherwise.

503.description: No learn controller is wired up.

post.description: Arms learn mode: the next physical input is reported over GET /events as a learn_input event and NOT dispatched as an action. Disarms itself after the first captured input or the timeout, whichever comes first.

503.description: No learn controller is wired up.

409.description: Not authorized yet -- connect via the Spotify tab first.

delete.description: Deletes the stored refresh token and clears the connection status.

post.description: Starts (or restarts) the PKCE authorization-code flow over a loopback redirect and returns the authorize URL. The daemon also makes a best-effort attempt to open it in a browser itself.

503.description: No Spotify Client ID is configured, or no SpotifyProvider is wired up.

get.description: For the binding editor's playlist picker (spotify.add_to_playlist/remove_from_playlist/start_playlist).

409.description: Not authorized yet -- connect via the Spotify tab first.

get.description: Device/audio/focus/profile status and every currently-bound control's resolved value. Pollable; see GET /events for a live push feed of the same shape.

503.description: No state provider is wired up.
